meta.name: render-vignette
meta.description: Assemble a short-form 'vignette' ad from clean product cutouts composited over a kinetic background video — birefnet cutout, then a cold-open text card + product carousel + annotated specimen-sheet end card, plus loudnorm + separate-pass music mux. FREE assembly (PIL + rsvg + FFmpeg); the recipe supplies the config and gates the paid BG/cutout/music calls to their own capabilities. Use for the vignette format.
